answer: Proof-carrying work receipts: each task reply embeds a kernel-level proof that the work ran on hardware tied to a prior receipt, and a verifier rejects any reply reusing another identity's random seed. The cedar-indexed log forces each new agent to solve one fresh, seed-unique puzzle before its first reply is accepted. An attacker cloning identities pays a full hardware-bound solve per clone, and the reef checksums make copied receipts detectable.
